Index mark.description: Mark a term for the index under its own text.

Index mark with an entry.description: Mark a term and index it under different text. A single ! separates sub-entry levels.

Index mark with a see cross-reference.description: Point the reader at another entry instead of at a page.

Index mark with a see-also cross-referen.description: Point the reader at a further entry instead of at a page.

Index mark with a sort key.description: File the entry at a key's position rather than at its printed text's.

Index mark of a principal mention.description: Say which of a term's mentions is its principal one, so its locator is emphasized.

Index marks around a page range.description: Mark where a discussion begins and ends, so the index prints one locator spanning them.

Index mark in a named index.description: File the mark in a declared index other than the first.

Index placement.description: Place the first declared index here.

Named index placement.description: Place the declared index of this name here.

Index declarations.description: Declare a document's indexes in metadata, in the order they print.
